_: How each file in assets/audio/ is cut for the web (scripts/encode-audio.mjs). start/len in seconds; loop: crossfade the tail into the head so it repeats seamlessly; peak: normalise to this peak (0..1); kbps: AAC bitrate. Everything is mono: sounds in a konbini come from a place or a ceiling speaker.

ka-ching._: Tan's ka-ching, as the IC card taps the self-checkout's reader (store/shop.js)

kiosk-scan._: Tan's self-checkout recording, 16.05-17.55 s: a hush, the scanner's beep (a pure 2.45 kHz tone at 16.2 s, 0.15 s into the cut: config STORE.kiosk.scanBeep), a second tone near 1.94 kHz, then the machine's short follow-up (voice-like, about 1 s)

kiosk-pay._: Tan's self-checkout recording, 26.55-30.5 s, its 0.65 s pause (29.0-29.65 s) silenced: the card reader's beep (2.93 kHz at 26.8 s, 0.25 s in: STORE.kiosk.payCard), a short voice, the paid beeps (2.63 and 3.04 kHz at 27.7 s, 1.15 s in: STORE.kiosk.payDone), the voice again (the thanks, 28.1-28.9 s) and the closing two-tone (1.57 then 1.31 kHz, 29.8-30.5 s)

lawson-chime._: the door chime (Tan's call, M3d): the whole phrase

walk-kakko._: the cuckoo call from Tan's recording: the main road's crossing (north-south)

walk-piyo._: the chick call: the side streets' crossings (east-west)

railway-bells._: the level crossing's bells, a whole number of bell periods

han-drift._: Tan's Han experience: played once when you talk to Han

donki-theme._: the discount megastore's theme, heard near it

shrine-chimes._: the shrine's wind chimes, heard in its grounds

rural-flute._: the slow-life spot by the paddies and the pond

station-ambience._: the station's announcements and bustle: full at the station, mild over the plaza (config SOUND.station)

train-nextstop._: the in-train announcement, played at the train's listening spot on platform 1 (nobody boards)

skip.scan-beep: 107 s of continuous low-level sound, not a single beep: M5 uses the procedural beep until a single-beep file is chosen
